checks: The city defaults to continuous external supply; finite research defaults and the boolean stabilization API remain explicit and compatible
Hold captures the exact world position and quaternion once, preserves initial velocities and brakes through finite-response physical valves
Newton and angular-momentum balances reconstruct the held vehicle response solely from delivered nozzle force, r × F torque and gravity
Supported combined pitch/roll attitudes converge to their captured pose and position, reject an external impulse, and retain finite braking overshoot
Unsupported attitudes, absent power, empty gas and undersized nozzles cannot freeze or support the vehicle; feasibility and residual expose the limitation
Finite-tank hold loses support as pressure and temperature fall and conserves every kilogram of delivered nozzle mass flow without hidden replenishment
Deliberate pilot inputs release research hold to manual attitude control, explicit raw-valve API inputs retain priority, and mode/suction/reset commands release stale references
Tire contact, hull contact and ceiling adhesion inhibit hold thrust without repeatedly relatching the captured world reference
Hold is independent of 30/60/144 Hz render cadence and converges when the actual physical integration step is halved

timestep.errorDefinition: position norm + velocity norm + quaternion angle (mixed-unit convergence diagnostic)

limits: Synthetic disturbance acceptance and exact static trim for the model nozzle layout; not an OEM controller identification or an arbitrary-attitude flight guarantee.
